title: Prove the one search on a main bundle

proofs.pass: (?s)J2 GREEN: .*J5 GREEN: .*\d+ checks, 0 failed, 0 not judged
(?s)\| J2 \| LOCAL .*\| GREEN \|.*\| J5 \| LOCAL .*\| GREEN \|

proofs.run: name the bundle label (WHOOSH_BUILD_LABEL / the Info.plist NexusBuildLabel read by perf/footprint.py:44 stamp) and the two COVERAGE rows (J2, J5 as printed by proof 2) in the evidence line, and ask the owner to use the search in that bundle
proofs.pass: bundle label <label>; COVERAGE rows J2 GREEN, J5 GREEN; owner: search used

owner: The owner uses the search in that bundle and says it works (the acceptance's own clause: 'the owner can use the search in that bundle'). The lead names the bundle label and, after proofs 0 to 2 pass, asks the owner to open the bundle and search; nothing here can stand in for that.
notes: Why proofs 0 to 2 are not yet satisfied: docs/COVERAGE.md:8 and :11 at this commit read J2 RED ('first failing check J2.1/skeleton-rows-fill-the-pane: ... PRODUCT GAP, no reader: measure mac-search.skeleton ...') and J5 RED ('first failing check J5.1/key-in-keychain-not-db'); those rows are old records, not a measure of this build. journeys/run.py (the file's docstring and main at :40-70) prints one stderr line per journey 'J<n> GREEN|RED|COULD-NOT-DRIVE: <steps>, <checks>, <failed>, <not judged>: <evidence>' and, last on stdout, 'N checks, F failed, U not judged'; it exits 1 unless every journey run is GREEN. IMPORTANT: a run with a journey filter does not rewrite docs/COVERAGE.md (journeys/run.py:62 `if not only and not dry`; journeys/README.md:9). So proof 0 (J2 and J5 only) judges them and proof 1 (the full run, J1 to J7, a long run, J7 is COULD-NOT-DRIVE on a Mac build by design, docs/COVERAGE.md:13) is the only run that updates docs/COVERAGE.md, and it exits 1 while J1, J3, J4, J6 are RED (their verdicts are not this item's). The updated COVERAGE.md is a tracked file: the lead commits the rewritten rows of J2 and J5 only if the full run is theirs to commit; proof 2 then reads them. A small gap that is NOT built here and is optional: a `--write-coverage` switch for a filtered run (journeys/run.py, size S) would let J2 and J5 update their own two rows without a full run; without it the lead must run all seven journeys. Journeys J2 and J5 are checks/parity-style journeys driven over the control socket on the fixture core, hidden via launch-one.sh with WHOOSH_RIG_HIDDEN=1 (journeys/README.md; J2.py and J5.py). The search work of lanes match-inside, match-evidence, reader-result, rows-engine, rows-screen, search-screen is the merge this item waits on ('after the merges'); a run on a commit without them reds the search steps. No mutants: the item is a run of existing journeys; the broken copies of each search behaviour are in items 64f2e8a7, 367f26ff, 6836382a, 9ce11c5a, d8153a57.
